items: Mix flour, sugar, 2 Tbsp cocoa, baking powder, and salt in an ungreased 9-inch square pan.
Mix in milk, oil, and vanilla until smooth. Stir in nuts. Spread evenly in pan.
Sprinkle with brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa. Pour hot water over batter.
Spoon warm cake into dessert dishes and top with ice cream. Spoon sauce from pan onto each serving.
